existing_group_assignments.rationale: Lung fibrosis is the same process as the existing 'Pulmonary fibrosis' member, in a different organ context from liver fibrosis.
HIF-1 activation concerns the same HIF-1 object as the HIF-1 heterodimer events, but is a distinct process.

new_groups.rationale: Collagen deposition is a specific ECM change, whereas modulation of ECM composition is a general ECM process, so they differ in specificity.
